item.title: Seattle police: Thieves snatch nearly $40K of copper wire from construction site
item.description: A construction site in Seattle's Ballard neighborhood has been targeted multiple times, according to SPD. This time, officers found two cars full of drugs linked to the suspected thieves.

item.title: 'Seattle News Weekly': Fallout over nonprofit fraud still plagues King Co. agency
item.description: On this episode of the "Seattle News Weekly" podcast, FOX 13 Seattle Anchor Hana Kim sits down with Converge Media’s Omari Salisbury, to discuss a recent scandal involving King County nonprofits

item.title: Seattle weather: Mainly dry through Saturday afternoon
item.description: High pressure will settle in over the Pacific Northwest bringing drier weather through Saturday afternoon.

item.title: Seattle LGBTQ bookstore frustrated after holiday delivery debacle
item.description: An LGBTQ bookstore in Fremont was not getting much-anticipated deliveries during the holiday shopping season, and the owners had no idea why.

item.title: Revive I-5 work begins this weekend in Seattle
item.description: WSDOT is warning drivers to plan ahead for traffic as crews announce that Revive I-5 work will resume this weekend.

item.title: WA leaders call for accountability after 2 people shot by Border Patrol in Portland
item.description: The shooting of two people in Portland by federal immigration agents is sparking political controversy across the nation, and in the Pacific Northwest. We look at how Washington leaders are reacting.

item.title: Port Orchard, WA police seek person of interest in teen's disappearance
item.description: Port Orchard police are searching for a person of interest in the disappearance of 15-year-old Ashlynn Hanley, missing since Dec. 10.

item.title: WA Gov. Ferguson eyes millionaire tax in 2026 Legislative Session
item.description: Gov. Ferguson, along with top state lawmakers from both sides of the aisle, discussed their priorities for the 2026 Legislative Session that begins on Monday.

item.title: Former Expedia employee gets 4 years in prison for Seattle bathroom spy camera case
item.description: A former Expedia employee was sentenced to four years in prison for a voyeurism scheme involving hidden bathroom cameras on the company’s Seattle campus.

item.title: Puyallup, WA protesters rally over ICE shooting, sheriff’s remarks
item.description: Protesters in Puyallup voiced anger over the fatal ICE shooting in Minneapolis, along with recent public statements from Pierce County Sheriff Keith Swank.
